title: Discovering Kazakhstan with FREE Trip to Charyn Canyon
highlights: Go on a mesmerizing journey to Charyn Canyon, a geological wonder often known as the "Grand Canyon's Little Brother," offering breathtaking views.
Explore Panfilov Park, featuring monuments and memorials commemorating bravery of the Panfilov Heroes who defended Moscow during World War II.
Treat your taste buds to a variety of delectable chocolate creations at Rahat Chocolate Factory, crafted using premium ingredients.
Discover Issyk Lake, situated around the Tien Shan mountains, known for its stunning turquoise waters and mountain views.
inclusions: Transfer from Almaty International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
6 nights stay in Almaty with breakfast

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Almaty
days.desc: Welcome to Almaty – City of thousand colors! Upon arrival at the Almaty Airport, you will get transferred to your hotel. Check-in and spend the rest of the day at your own pace. You can explore nearby places or visit various attractions including Panfilov Park, Zilyoni Bazaar, Medeu Dam, and many more. Later, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Almaty Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to go on a sightseeing tour of Almaty. During the tour, visit various amazing attractions, including Panfilov Park, dedicated to the Panfilove heroes who participated in World War II. Further, visit the beautiful Ascension Cathedral, a famous Russian Orthodox Cathedral. Afterward, explore the beautiful Republic Square and witness the Monument of Independence, known as the symbol of freedom for Kazakhstan. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Almaty City Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort
days.desc: This day is for you to enjoy the beautiful mountains surrounding Almaty City with a day trip to Shymbulak Ski Resort and Medeu Ice Skating Rink. At Medeu, enjoy skiing in one of the largest alpine skating rinks in the world. Next, hop on a cable car for a cool ride up to Shymbulak Ski Resort, enjoying amazing views on the way up. Discover the remarkable scenery and enjoy panoramic views of the surroundings on the way. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort on a Private basis

days.title: Day Trip to Green Bazaar & Rahat Chocolate Factory | Visit to Kok Tobe Park
days.desc: Begin your day by getting transferred to Green Bazaar. Here, you can buy all kinds of items, from souvenirs to clothes and snacks. Further, enjoy a visit to the Rahat Chocolate Factory to see the process of chocolate as you buy a few of them. After the visit to a chocolate factory, get ready to board your cable car to Kok Tobe Park, where you can enjoy rides and admire the views of the panoramic surroundings. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay

days.title: Day Trip to Issyk Lake
days.desc: Admire the beauty of Issky Lake, as you go on a wonderful day trip. As you reach the lake, enjoy a leisurely walk around the shores as you take-in the views of the surroundings. Also, visit the State Historical and Cultural Museum-Reserve and learn about the area's past and history. After exploring the place, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Issyk Lake Day Tour From Almaty on a Private basis
Issyk State Historical and Cultural Reserve-Museum

days.title: Day Trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to go for the day trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake. Begin with a visit to the majestic Charyn Canyon, often likened to the Grand Canyon, featuring dramatic rock formations carved over millennia. Then, discover the Kolsai Lake, situated around the Tien Shan mountains. After exploring these  amazing attractions, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake From Almaty on a Private basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the airport for your flight back home. Do not forget to pack amazing memories and souvenirs with you!
